description: Scaffold verification for the SLM Reranker external scorer protocol. This report validates that the benchmark harness functions correctly. No real tiny-LLM model was evaluated.

scorers_tested.name: builtin-mock
scorers_tested.description: Built-in no-op mock that returns empty string. Does not claim any accuracy improvement. Validates the runner processes all cases and measures latency correctly.

scorers_tested.name: mock-tiny-llm-scorer
scorers_tested.description: External mock scorer returning empty baseline output. Demonstrates the subprocess invocation protocol, timeout enforcement, and fallback counting.

scorers_tested.name: mock-tiny-llm-scorer-oracle
scorers_tested.description: Oracle mock that returns the expected field from each request. Used to verify the runner correctly detects exact matches. 100% accuracy is expected — this is not a real model.

capabilities_verified: JSONL fixture parsing with varying field sets
Fallback detection: timeout, non-zero exit, invalid JSON, missing output field
Summary JSON with latency percentiles and fallback breakdown
Privacy: no content-bearing data in report or per-case output beyond fixture IDs
conclusion: Scaffold verified. The benchmark harness correctly processes 234 fixture cases, invokes external scorer commands, enforces timeouts, counts fallbacks, and produces reproducible reports. No real SLM was evaluated. No changes were made to the macOS live IME or C++ engine.
next_steps: Implement llama.cpp wrapper scorer that conforms to the JSON stdin/stdout protocol
Benchmark 200M–0.5B quantized models (e.g., Qwen2.5-0.5B, Gemma-2-2B-it-Q4) on the three fixture suites
Establish per-fixture baseline accuracy with deterministic reranker for comparison
Gate: any candidate SLM must beat deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures before promotable to Phase 3 runtime integration
